q: A company must ensure that no Amazon S3 bucket in its accounts allows public access. If the Block Public Access settings on a bucket are disabled, the settings must be re-enabled automatically within minutes, and the compliance status must be recorded for audits. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Use the AWS Config managed rule s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited with an automatic remediation action that runs the AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook AWSConfigRemediation-ConfigureS3BucketPublicAccessBlock.
Write an AWS Lambda function that runs every 24 hours, lists all buckets, and re-enables Block Public Access on each bucket.
Enable Amazon Macie and manually review the findings about public buckets every week.
Use AWS Trusted Advisor checks for S3 bucket permissions and email the bucket owners to fix any issues.
exp: AWS Config managed rule đánh giá cấu hình mỗi khi bucket thay đổi và lưu lịch sử tuân thủ cho audit; automatic remediation gọi SSM Automation runbook do AWS cung cấp để bật lại Block Public Access mà không cần viết code. Lambda chạy 24 giờ một lần không đáp ứng yêu cầu vài phút và phải tự duy trì. Macie và Trusted Advisor chỉ phát hiện, cần xử lý thủ công.

q: A company uses AWS Organizations with 40 accounts. The company must deploy the same set of IAM roles, an Amazon SNS topic, and AWS Config rules to every account in three AWS Regions. New accounts that are added to specific organizational units (OUs) must receive the resources automatically. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Write a script that loops through all accounts, assumes a role in each account, and runs the AWS CloudFormation deploy command in each Region.
Share the AWS CloudFormation template with every account by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) so that each account team can deploy it.
Create an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment in each account and Region to deploy the resources.
Create an AWS CloudFormation StackSet with service-managed permissions that targets the OUs in the three Regions, and enable automatic deployment for accounts that are added to the OUs.
exp: CloudFormation StackSets triển khai cùng một template vào nhiều tài khoản và Region từ một nơi; với service-managed permissions tích hợp Organizations, automatic deployment tự tạo stack khi có tài khoản mới vào OU và có thể xóa stack khi tài khoản rời OU. Script tự viết tốn công duy trì và không tự xử lý tài khoản mới. AWS RAM không chia sẻ được template CloudFormation; Elastic Beanstalk dùng để triển khai ứng dụng.

q: A company manages 300 Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Administrators currently connect through a bastion host by using SSH keys that are shared among the team. The security team wants to remove the bastion host, close inbound port 22, stop managing SSH keys, and log all session activity to Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?
options: Replace the bastion host with an AWS Client VPN endpoint and continue to use the shared SSH keys.

Ensure that the SSM Agent is running, attach an instance profile with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy, create VPC interface endpoints for Systems Manager, and use Session Manager with session logging to Amazon S3.
Assign a public IP address to each instance, open port 22 to the administrators' IP ranges, and use EC2 Instance Connect.
Move the bastion host to a public subnet in another VPC and use VPC peering to reach the instances.
exp: Session Manager của AWS Systems Manager cho phép mở shell qua SSM Agent mà không cần mở inbound port, không cần bastion hay SSH key; quyền truy cập kiểm soát bằng IAM và có thể ghi log phiên vào S3/CloudWatch Logs. VPC endpoint (ssm, ssmmessages, ec2messages) giúp instance trong private subnet kết nối mà không cần internet. Client VPN và bastion mới vẫn dùng SSH key chung; gán public IP và mở port 22 đi ngược yêu cầu bảo mật.

q: A company runs an order management application on Amazon EC2 instances with an Amazon RDS for MySQL database in us-east-1. The company needs a disaster recovery strategy in us-west-2 with an RPO of 5 minutes and an RTO of 1 hour. The company wants to minimize costs and does not want to run any application servers in us-west-2 unless a disaster occurs. Which DR strategy will meet these requirements?
options: Backup and restore: take daily RDS snapshots, copy them to us-west-2, and restore the entire environment during a disaster.
Warm standby: run a scaled-down but fully functional copy of the application tier and database in us-west-2 at all times.
Pilot light: maintain a cross-Region RDS read replica in us-west-2, keep current AMIs and infrastructure as code ready, and launch the application tier and promote the replica during a disaster.
Multi-site active/active: run full production capacity in both Regions and use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to both Regions.
exp: Pilot light giữ phần lõi (dữ liệu) luôn được replicate liên tục nên RPO chỉ vài giây đến vài phút, còn tầng ứng dụng chỉ được khởi tạo khi có thảm họa nên chi phí thấp và RTO cỡ vài chục phút. Snapshot hằng ngày cho RPO 24 giờ, không đạt 5 phút. Warm standby và multi-site đều chạy application server liên tục ở us-west-2, trái yêu cầu và tốn kém hơn.

q: A company runs an internal HR application on Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon EBS volumes and an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The business has agreed to an RTO of 24 hours and an RPO of 24 hours for a Regional disaster. The company wants centralized management of backups. Which disaster recovery solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
options: Use AWS Backup with a daily backup plan for the EC2 instances and the RDS database, configure cross-Region copy of recovery points to a backup vault in another Region, and restore by using infrastructure as code when needed.
Implement a pilot light environment with a cross-Region RDS read replica and up-to-date AMIs in another Region.
Run a warm standby environment with a scaled-down Auto Scaling group and an RDS read replica in another Region.
Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery to continuously replicate the servers to a staging area in another Region.
exp: Với RTO và RPO 24 giờ, backup and restore là chiến lược rẻ nhất vẫn đáp ứng yêu cầu. AWS Backup quản lý tập trung lịch backup cho EC2/EBS và RDS, đồng thời tự copy recovery point sang Region khác. Pilot light, warm standby và Elastic Disaster Recovery đều phải trả tiền cho replication liên tục hoặc tài nguyên luôn chạy, vượt quá nhu cầu RTO/RPO tính bằng giờ.

q: A company's payment portal runs on Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer and uses Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The company requires an RTO of 10 minutes and an RPO of less than 1 minute for a Regional failure. During failover, the DR environment must serve production traffic immediately at reduced capacity while it scales up. The company wants to avoid the cost of running full production capacity in two Regions. Which DR strategy will meet these requirements?
options: Backup and restore that uses AWS Backup to copy Aurora and configuration backups to the DR Region every hour.
Pilot light that uses an Aurora global database secondary cluster, with the ECS cluster, services, and ALB created only after a disaster is declared.
Multi-site active/active with full production capacity in both Regions and Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing.

Warm standby that uses an Aurora global database secondary cluster and a small ECS service with a few running tasks behind an ALB in the DR Region, with Route 53 failover routing and scaling up after failover.
exp: Warm standby duy trì một bản sao thu nhỏ nhưng đầy đủ chức năng luôn chạy ở Region DR, nên có thể nhận traffic ngay và scale lên trong vài phút; Aurora global database đảm bảo RPO dưới 1 giây. Backup mỗi giờ không đạt RPO 1 phút; pilot light phải tạo hạ tầng ứng dụng khi có sự cố nên không phục vụ được traffic ngay. Active/active đáp ứng nhưng tốn chi phí chạy full capacity ở hai Region.

q: A company gives each development team a sandbox AWS account with a monthly spending limit of $2,000. The finance team wants team leads to receive an email when forecasted spend reaches 80% of the limit. When actual spend exceeds 100% of the limit, the company wants to automatically prevent the team from launching new Amazon EC2 instances in that account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection with a cost monitor for each account and an Amazon SNS subscription for the team leads.

Create a cost budget in AWS Budgets for each account with an alert at 80% of forecasted cost to the team leads, and a budget action at 100% of actual cost that applies an SCP that denies ec2:RunInstances to the account.
Create an Amazon CloudWatch billing alarm in each account and write an AWS Lambda function that terminates all EC2 instances when the alarm enters the ALARM state.
Review the daily cost report in AWS Cost Explorer each morning and manually remove the team's IAM permissions when the limit is exceeded.
exp: AWS Budgets hỗ trợ cảnh báo theo chi phí dự báo (forecasted) và thực tế, cùng budget actions tự động áp dụng IAM policy, SCP hoặc dừng EC2/RDS khi vượt ngưỡng, không cần viết code. Cost Anomaly Detection phát hiện chi tiêu bất thường chứ không theo hạn mức cố định và không tự chặn tài nguyên. Billing alarm kèm Lambda tự viết tốn công hơn và việc xóa mọi instance quá mạnh tay; theo dõi thủ công không đáp ứng yêu cầu tự động.

q: A company has run a steady baseline of Amazon EC2 and AWS Fargate workloads for the past year, and usage is expected to remain stable or grow. The company wants to commit to an appropriate hourly spend for a 1-year Savings Plan based on its actual historical usage, without building its own analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?
options: Use AWS Trusted Advisor to list idle load balancers and use the results to calculate a commitment.
Export detailed billing data to Amazon S3 and build custom dashboards to estimate the hourly commitment manually.
Use the Savings Plans recommendations in AWS Cost Explorer, select Compute Savings Plans with a 1-year term and an appropriate lookback period, and purchase the recommended hourly commitment.
Use AWS Compute Optimizer to automatically purchase Reserved Instances for each EC2 instance type.
exp: Cost Explorer đưa ra Savings Plans recommendations dựa trên lịch sử sử dụng thực tế (lookback 7, 30 hoặc 60 ngày), tính sẵn mức cam kết theo giờ và mức tiết kiệm ước tính cho từng loại plan và kỳ hạn. Tự xây dashboard tốn công không cần thiết. Trusted Advisor về idle load balancer không liên quan đến cam kết compute; Compute Optimizer đưa ra khuyến nghị rightsizing và không tự mua Reserved Instances.

q: A company has several product teams that share one AWS account. Each team tags its resources with a team key. The finance department needs monthly costs broken down by team and wants a detailed, line-item dataset that it can query with Amazon Athena. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
options: Create a separate VPC for each team and use VPC Flow Logs to calculate each team's costs.
Activate the team tag as a user-defined cost allocation tag in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console.
Enable AWS Config to record the team tag on each resource and export the configuration history to the finance department.
Configure AWS Budgets reports to email each team's spending summary to the finance department once a month.
Create a Cost and Usage Report (CUR 2.0) export in AWS Data Exports that includes resource tags and delivers Parquet files to Amazon S3 for querying with Athena.
exp: Tag chỉ xuất hiện trong dữ liệu billing sau khi được kích hoạt làm cost allocation tag. CUR 2.0 qua AWS Data Exports cung cấp dữ liệu chi tiết từng dòng (line-item) kèm cột tag, xuất ra S3 dạng Parquet để truy vấn bằng Athena và phân bổ chi phí theo team. Flow Logs và AWS Config không chứa thông tin chi phí; báo cáo Budgets chỉ là bản tóm tắt, không phải dataset chi tiết.

q: A company runs 500 Amazon EC2 instances, many Amazon EBS volumes, and many AWS Lambda functions. Most instances were sized years ago, and the company suspects that they are overprovisioned. The company wants recommendations for better instance types and sizes that are based on actual utilization, including memory utilization. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?
options: Opt in to AWS Compute Optimizer for the organization, install the Amazon CloudWatch agent to publish memory metrics, and review the rightsizing recommendations for EC2, EBS, and Lambda.
Use a monthly AWS Cost Explorer report filtered by instance type to identify the most expensive instances, and downsize all of them by one size.
Purchase Savings Plans for the existing instance types to reduce their hourly cost.
Use Amazon Inspector to analyze the utilization of the instances and recommend new instance types.
exp: AWS Compute Optimizer dùng machine learning phân tích metric CloudWatch lịch sử để đề xuất rightsizing cho EC2, Auto Scaling groups, EBS, Lambda, ECS trên Fargate và RDS. Memory không phải metric mặc định của EC2 nên cần CloudWatch agent để khuyến nghị chính xác hơn. Hạ size đồng loạt dựa trên chi phí có thể làm thiếu tài nguyên; Savings Plans giảm giá nhưng không sửa việc overprovisioning; Inspector dùng để quét lỗ hổng bảo mật.
